# Hitflix

> Hitflix is a free, ad-free web app to rate movies, build movie ranking lists, play daily movie games, and search for movie information. It does not impersonate or claim affiliation with any person, studio, streaming service, or organization.

## About

Hitflix lets visitors, in order of priority:
1. Rate movies with a personal scoring system covering writing, performance, visuals, and audio.
2. Build ranked or unranked lists of movies, with optional "honorable mentions."
3. Play four daily movie games (below).
4. Search for movie titles and basic information — release date, director, budget, box office, awards.

There is nothing to buy, no ads, and no account required.

## Pages

- [Hitflix](https://hitflix.club/): rate movies, build ranking lists, and search for movie information.
- [Daily Movie](https://hitflix.club/games/daily): a Wordle-style puzzle — guess the featured movie in 5 tries. Its genre is revealed upfront as a clue. Guesses can be any film findable on Wikipedia; each guess is scored against the featured movie's year, director, production country, cast, runtime, and Oscar nomination count.
- [Daily Movie (Oscar Edition)](https://hitflix.club/games/daily-oscar-edition): the same format, but the movie is drawn only from actual Oscar winners, and both its genre and the category it won are revealed upfront as clues.
- [Faceoff](https://hitflix.club/games/faceoff): 5 head-to-head rounds, each pitting two movies with a similar genre against each other — pick the one with the bigger worldwide box office gross. Ends with a percentage score.
- [Faceoff (Oscar Edition)](https://hitflix.club/games/faceoff-oscar-edition): the same head-to-head format as Faceoff, but pick the movie with more Oscar nominations instead of the bigger box office gross.

All four daily games are picked deterministically by date (same puzzle for every visitor, no server needed).

## Details

- Purpose: rate movies, build movie ranking lists, play daily movie games, and search for movie information — nothing else.
- Cost: completely free to use, no ads, no paywalls, no premium tier.
- Accounts: none. Nothing to sign up for.
- Data storage: all lists and ratings are stored only in the visitor's own browser (localStorage). There is no backend server or database, no data is transmitted to or retained by this site, and nothing is shared, sold, or made public.
- Tracking: no analytics, no cookies, no tracking of any kind.
- Content sources: movie search results and metadata (title, description, poster, release date, director, budget, box office, awards) are fetched live, client-side, from Wikipedia's and Wikidata's public APIs at read time. This site does not host, claim ownership of, or redistribute that content.
- Identity: this is an independent hobby project. It does not impersonate, represent, or claim affiliation with any movie studio, streaming service, news outlet, or public figure.
